settings.title: Settings
settings.check_updates_on_startup: Check for updates when ExaTerm starts
settings.check_updates_on_startup_desc: Checks the latest published stable release once at startup; updates are installed only after confirmation
settings.shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
settings.shortcuts.help: Select an assignment and press a shortcut. Printable keys require Ctrl or Alt; F1–F12 can be assigned by themselves.
settings.shortcuts.invalid: Use Ctrl or Alt with a printable key, or use F1–F12.
settings.shortcuts.conflict: This shortcut is already assigned to {{action}}.
settings.ai_provider_status_note: Shows saved configuration status only; connection is not tested.
settings.azure_openai_enabled_desc: Uses the Azure OpenAI v1 API with the configured model deployment
settings.ollama_enabled_desc: When enabled, available Ollama models are shown in the AI panel
settings.mcp_enabled_desc: Master permission for trusted local CLI and MCP clients; enable each interface separately
settings.mcp_children_disabled_desc: Enable external control to change these interfaces.
settings.mcp_stdio_enabled_desc: Lets local MCP clients launch exaterm-mcp and use the existing MCP integration through the ExaTerm GUI
settings.mcp_cli_enabled_desc: Primary external-control path for trusted local processes using exaterm-cli
settings.mcp_connect_enabled_desc: Lets trusted external-control clients open saved SSH/Telnet profiles and Serial consoles
settings.ssh_algorithm_mode_desc: Applies to new direct, jump-host, and externally started SSH connections.
settings.ssh_algorithm_catalog_failed: Could not load the available SSH algorithms.
settings.ssh_algorithm_custom_desc: Select at least one algorithm in every category. Negotiation uses ExaTerm's built-in priority order.
settings.auto_session_log_desc: When enabled, SSH/Serial/Telnet terminal input and output are saved as plaintext logs
settings.include_log_header_desc: Adds session type, target, mode, and start time at the beginning of new log files
settings.secret_clear_confirm_message: Clear this saved API key from the OS credential store?
settings.secret_clear_failed: Failed to clear the API key.
connection.jump_profile_not_found: SSH jump host profile "{{profile}}" was not found.
connection.jump_profile_incomplete: SSH jump host profile "{{profile}}" is missing a host or username.
connection.jump_profile_nested: Nested SSH jump host profiles are not supported.
connection.jump_profile_self: A profile cannot use itself as a jump host.
connection.password_prompt_desc: Enter the SSH password for this connection.
connection.key_passphrase_prompt_desc: Enter the passphrase for the selected encrypted private key.
connection.profile_memo_placeholder: Device model, role, or operational notes
connection.profile_memo_mcp_notice: Memos may be shared with trusted external-control clients through profile listing.
connection.profile_mcp_enabled_help: When enabled, trusted CLI and MCP clients can list and open this saved profile if global external connection access is also enabled.
connection.profile_duplicate: A profile with this name already exists.
connection.startup_profile_incomplete: SSH profile "{{profile}}" is missing a host or username.
connection.startup_telnet_profile_incomp: Telnet profile "{{profile}}" is missing a host.
connection.host_key_unknown.title: Verify SSH Host Key
connection.host_key_unknown.message: The host key for {{host}}:{{port}} is not trusted yet. Verify the fingerprint before connecting.
connection.host_key_mismatch.title: SSH Host Key Changed
connection.host_key_mismatch.message: The stored host key for {{host}}:{{port}} does not match the key presented by the server. This may indicate a man-in-the-middle attack.
connection.host_key_warning: Confirm that the displayed host key belongs to the server you expect before continuing.
mcp.credential_request_desc: A trusted local external-control client requested a saved SSH profile connection. Enter the credential in ExaTerm; it is not sent to the external client or saved.
logs.title: Session Logs
logs.delete_confirm_history: Delete session log history. Log files will remain.
logs.delete_confirm_files: Delete session log history and auto log files. Manual log files will remain. This cannot be undone.
logs.delete_dialog_message: Delete session log history. Do you also want to delete auto log files? Manual log files will remain.
logs.delete_result: Deleted {{history}} history entries and {{files}} auto log files. Skipped active: {{active}}, manual files: {{manual}}, missing files: {{missing}}, unsafe paths: {{unsafe}}.

exit.active_sessions_detail: Exiting closes all ExaTerm windows and ends all active SSH, Telnet, and Serial connections. Confirm that your terminal work is safe to stop before continuing.
updates.title: ExaTerm Update
updates.up_to_date: You are using the latest version.
updates.active_sessions_warning: {{count}} connected terminal session(s) will be closed.
updates.active_sessions_detail: Updating exits ExaTerm and ends all active SSH, Telnet, and Serial connections. Confirm that your terminal work is safe to stop before continuing.
updates.downloading: Downloading and verifying the update. This cannot be cancelled.
updates.installing: The update is ready. ExaTerm will close while Windows installs it.
updates.failed: The update could not be completed.
updates.failed_detail: Check your network connection and try again. Your current installation has not been replaced.
